attchmntText: Shiva Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the  Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter/six months ended 30.9.2026.
voiceSummary: Shiva Mills Limited submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30.9.2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 12.11.2026. Statutory auditors M/s CSR & Co. completed a limited review. For the half-year ended 30.9.2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 8,966.70 lakh. Net profit was Rs. 778.54 lakh. Earnings per share were Rs. 9.01. For the quarter ended 30.9.2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 5,156.97 lakh. Net profit was Rs. 495.77 lakh. Earnings per share were Rs. 5.74. Total assets as at 30.9.2026 stood at Rs. 11,356.22 lakh. Cash and cash equivalents were Rs. 772.87 lakh. The company operates in the textile business segment.

attchmntText: Shiva Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding Special window for transfer and dematerialisation of physical shares.
